plugins.name: NyashkChannel
plugins.description: SSL-style channel strip: input stage, filters, expander / gate, compressor and a 4-band EQ in one plugin.
plugins.long: A complete console channel in one plugin, in the spirit of the SSL E / G channel: input section with line and mic gain, high-pass and low-pass filters, expander / gate, compressor with auto makeup, a four-band EQ (BROWN and BLACK voicing), and an output fader with width and mono.
features: Live output spectrum behind the EQ curve
Input: polarity, -20 dB pad, line trim, mic gain, ANALOG saturation
HP 18 dB/oct and LP filters, optionally on the dynamics sidechain only (SPLIT)
Expander / gate with threshold, range, release and fast attack
Compressor with soft knee, ratio up to infinity, release, fast attack and auto makeup
Dynamics before or after the EQ
4-band EQ: LF and HF shelf or bell, LMF and HMF with Q, BROWN / BLACK character
Output fader, stereo width and mono, in / out and gain reduction meters

plugins.name: NyashkEQ
plugins.description: 4-band parametric EQ with HP / LP, draggable nodes over a live spectrum, mid / side mode and analog stage.
plugins.long: A clean four-band parametric equalizer in the style of a classic console EQ. Drag the nodes on the graph, see the live spectrum behind the curve, and work in stereo, mid or side. BLACK and BROWN voicings change how bands behave.
features: Draggable nodes over a live spectrum analyser
HP 18 dB/oct and LP filters
LF and HF shelf or bell, two fully parametric mid bands
STEREO, MID and SIDE processing
BLACK and BROWN voicing, optional ANALOG stage
Phase invert, output gain, click-free bypass

plugins.name: NyashkAir
plugins.description: Adds smooth air and presence to vocals and mixes without harshness.
plugins.long: An air and presence exciter in the spirit of Slate Fresh Air. Two knobs add brightness and openness in the mids and highs, with dynamic reduction so it does not get harsh, and a live curve that shows exactly what is being added.
features: Live spectrum of input and output behind the air curve
MID AIR and HIGH AIR knobs, LINK to move them together
Dynamic reduction keeps the top smooth
Live curve of the added energy
Input / output meters and trim, click-free power

plugins.name: NyashkPre
plugins.description: Light vocal preamp and saturator with tube, iron and clean character plus a simple tone section.
plugins.long: A light vocal preamp: gain and drive into three characters (tube, iron transformer, clean solid-state) followed by low cut, warmth, presence and silk. Auto level keeps loudness steady while you set the sound.
features: Live spectrum behind the tone curve and a live trace on the saturation curve
Gain and Drive with saturation curve display
TUBE, IRON and CLEAN character
Low cut, Warmth, Presence and Silk tone controls
Parallel MIX, AUTO LEVEL, polarity, output

plugins.name: NyashkMeter
plugins.description: Master-bus analyser: LUFS (momentary, short-term, integrated), LRA, true peak, spectrum, stereo and tonal balance.
plugins.long: A mastering meter that passes audio through untouched. ITU-R BS.1770-4 loudness with momentary, short-term and gated integrated LUFS, loudness range, true peak, a spectrum with selectable source, goniometer, correlation, loudness history and tonal balance.
features: Momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, LRA, max values
Targets: -9, -14, -16, -23 LUFS with history line
True peak (4x), sample peak, PLR and overs count
Spectrum: curve or 1/3 octave, L+R / MID / SIDE / L / R, slopes, speed, hold
Goniometer, correlation and balance
Tonal balance across six bands
Loudness history 1 or 5 minutes

plugins.name: DauBiko
plugins.description: All-in-one master bus: tone EQ, one DYNAMICS knob from glue to punch, tape / tube color, width and a lookahead limiter.
plugins.long: An analog-style mastering processor with a worn vintage console face: brushed and scratched metal, machined aluminium knobs, chrome toggles, backlit VU meters and an amber screen with the live spectrum. Shape the tone, set the dynamics with one big knob (left glues the mix together, right makes it punch), add tape or tube color, adjust the stereo image and finish with a lookahead limiter.
features: Tone: low cut, LOW 80 Hz, BODY 250 Hz, PRESENCE 3.2 kHz, AIR 12 kHz and TILT, with a live curve
DYNAMICS knob: GLUE (bus compression with auto makeup) to PUNCH (transient lift, tighter tails), 1 ms lookahead
COLOR: TAPE or TUBE saturation, 2x oversampled
STEREO: width 0 to 200 % and BASS MONO below 120 Hz
OUTPUT: gain into a 1.5 ms lookahead limiter with ceiling
VU meters, live spectrum, gain change and limiter LEDs, click-free bypass, resizable window

plugins.name: NyashkOpto
plugins.description: LA-2A style optical compressor with program-dependent attack, two-stage release, compress / limit modes and analog hum + saturation.
plugins.long: A model of an optical (opto-cell) compressor in the spirit of the LA-2A. Attack is program-dependent and release is two-stage with memory, so it breathes like the hardware. Simple to use: Peak Reduction and Gain do most of the work.
features: Live waveform (input / output) with the gain reduction line
Peak Reduction: amount of compression; Gain: output level
COMPRESS or LIMIT mode
Hi Freq (HF Follow): emphasis in the sidechain to tame sibilance
ANALOG: OFF / 50 Hz / 60 Hz soft saturation with mains hum, like real hardware
Mix for parallel compression, Auto Makeup and Trim
VU meter with INPUT, GR and OUTPUT views
Transparent at Peak Reduction 0, click-free bypass

plugins.name: NyashkTune
plugins.description: Autotune from transparent natural correction to the hard T-Pain effect, with formant control, voices and a preset browser.
plugins.long: Realtime vocal pitch correction, from transparent natural tuning to the hard T-Pain effect. YIN pitch detection with PSOLA resynthesis, 16 scales plus a custom one, formant control, harmony voices and a preset browser.
features: Sharps and flats: both spellings on every black key, the ♯ / ♭ switch picks the one used everywhere
ULTRA: MIDI-like hard steps between notes, dead flat on the note, with an on / off switch
YIN pitch detection with continuity tracking (no octave jumps), PSOLA resynthesis, mono and stereo
16 scales plus Custom, key and reference A4; per-note BYPASS for blue notes and slides
Retune Speed from natural to hard, Flex-Tune, Humanize, Natural Vibrato, synthetic vibrato with four shapes
MIDI Target: tune to the notes you play
Transpose, Detune and Formant Shift with 5 algorithms
2 extra voices (harmony, octave, double) with interval, pan, detune and delay
Air and Drive colour, voice ranges from Bass to Soprano
28 presets (including Anime Vocal) and your own saved presets
